newsitem.title: USA: Three dead, 10 missing in rest-home fire.
newsitem.headline: Three dead, 10 missing in rest-home fire.

text.p: At least three people were killed and 10 were missing Wednesday after a fire raced through a Pennsylvania rest home, authorities said.

Rescue workers searched the rubble for the missing residents, and fire officials said they were uncertain of the final death toll. The three known to have died were rescued from the fire but perished later in a hospital.
Authorities were investigating whether a boiler explosion Tuesday night might have caused the fire. The building housed 21 residents in Harvey's Lake, Pa., about 130 miles northwest of Philadelphia.
The home had been purchased 13 days before the fire by W.P. Equities Inc., of Kingston, Pa.
"It's our biggest nightmare come true," company chief executive officer Paul Pugliese said.
